objective_text: Fix BibleWeapon exception during chest pickup by resolving the TouchDamage Collider dependency and self-referencing prefab loop.
Fix the EnemyData reference defect where 22 active enemy/boss prefabs reference a missing or broken GUID 01217a48f2e5cb44588556a395026c0a.
Implement missing JsonUtility.FromJsonOverwrite in standalone regression mock to fix CS0117.
Wire VFXPoolManager securely into the core BootstrapInstaller or global persistent scene.
Wire Magnet and Orologion (TimeFreeze) prefabs in the Scene Installer / PickupPoolManager to avoid runtime primitive fallbacks.
Prove and secure deterministic serialized/runtime ownership for AudioManager.cs by wiring it into the Core BootstrapInstaller or global persistent scene.
Wire GameSessionManager explicitly into the BootstrapInstaller or global persistent scene, resolving the VSSystemsDynamicSpawner primitive fallback.
Refactor InfiniteMap to remove the fallback GameObject.FindWithTag('Player') lookup from the Update loop and inject the player reference deterministically.

Add an EditMode test to verify EventBus Subscription, Raise, and Unsubscribe mechanics. Ensure that a raised event reaches subscribers and that disposed EventSubscriptions correctly prevent further notifications without causing leaks.
Add an EditMode test for SimpleServiceContainer to verify deterministic Add and Get storage contracts.

Add a discoverable PlayMode smoke test exercising the production InputService initialization, virtual keyboard input, and delivery of PauseToggleEvent through the production EventBus. Verify repeated initialization does not duplicate delivery and disposal prevents subsequent input notifications.
Add a PlayMode smoke test that loads the Bootstrap scene and verifies the GameServices startup sequence.
Add an EditMode test for PlayerStats to verify deterministic stat calculations, boundaries, and Revival logic.
Add an EditMode test for RunStatsTracker to verify deterministic kill counting, gold accumulation, and damage tracking logic.
Add a PlayMode test instantiating Hero_1_0.prefab, injecting an EventBus, and firing a PlayerMoveEvent to verify PlayerController correctly applies velocity to its Rigidbody.
Add a discoverable PlayMode smoke test that instantiates LevelProgressionManager and validates its stage initialization and StageElapsedTime progression across frames.
Add a PlayMode test for DamagePopupManager to verify it spawns, pools, and reuses damage text popups deterministically without GC allocations.

Add a PlayMode smoke test that instantiates a GameObject with HealthController, applies a DamagePacket, and validates that health correctly decreases and the KinematicKnockback coroutine safely executes without exceptions.
Resolve the zero-discovery blocker by creating a proper PlayMode assembly definition (SoulHunter.Tests.PlayMode.asmdef) and add a PlayMode smoke test for GameSessionManager.

Resolve the zero-discovery blocker by creating a proper PlayMode assembly definition (SoulHunter.Tests.PlayMode.asmdef) and add a PlayMode smoke test that loads Bootstrap.unity and verifies GameServices initialization.

Add a discoverable PlayMode UnityTest for the existing WeaponPoolManager -> PooledLifetime -> AutoReturnToPool runtime path. Create an isolated manager and an inactive test-owned projectile template with a non-kinematic Rigidbody. Acquire a projectile through GetFromPool, assign nonzero velocities, arm its production PooledLifetime with zero duration, and observe deactivation across a bounded number of frames. Reacquire and assert identical object identity, active state, requested position and rotation, and reset linear/angular velocity. Add the missing PlayMode test assembly referencing SoulHunter.Gameplay and Unity Test Framework, without Editor-only platform restriction. Clean up all test-owned objects and restore any changed global state; preserve production behavior.
Create PlayMode test assembly and test EconomyService's integration with SaveService in a simulated PlayMode frame loop.

Create PlayMode assembly definition (SoulHunter.Tests.PlayMode.asmdef) and a PlayMode test for EventBus. Verify subscription, publishing, and unsubscription in a PlayMode environment to prove fundamental event delivery.

Resolve the zero-discovery PlayMode blocker by creating SoulHunter.Tests.PlayMode.asmdef (if missing) and adding a PlayMode smoke test for DamageCaster. Instantiate a target with HealthController on a target layer, instantiate a DamageCaster with a matching layer mask, call CastDamage(), and assert the target takes damage.

Resolve the zero-discovery PlayMode blocker by creating SoulHunter.Tests.PlayMode.asmdef (referencing SoulHunter.Gameplay and UnityEngine.TestRunner) without Editor constraints. Add a PlayMode UnityTest for CameraFollow that instantiates a camera and a target, assigns the target, waits multiple frames using yield return null, and asserts that the camera's position successfully interpolates toward the target using Time.deltaTime.

Resolve the zero-discovery blocker by creating the missing PlayMode assembly definition (SoulHunter.Tests.PlayMode.asmdef) and adding an isolated PlayMode smoke test for RunStatsTracker. Instantiate a GameObject, attach RunStatsTracker, call AddKill() and AddGold(), yield for one frame, and assert that TotalKills and TotalGoldCollected increment correctly. This verifies a deterministic Unity runtime path without external dependencies.
Add an EditMode test for LevelUpManager to verify option generation from the GameContentCatalog.

Add an end-to-end PlayMode smoke test that loads Bootstrap, waits for the SceneService to transition through Loading to MainMenu, initiates Main_Gameplay, simulates a Game Over condition, and triggers a restart.
Refactor CameraFollow to remove the GameObject.FindWithTag('Player') fallback lookup in LateUpdate(), injecting the target transform explicitly during scene initialization.
Refactor ShadowKaelController to remove the GameObject.FindWithTag('Player') fallback.

Refactor EnemyDrop to remove the GameObject.FindWithTag('Player') fallback lookup in HandleDeath, instead fetching the player reference securely from the attached EnemyController's Target or via FindFirstObjectByType.
Refactor EnemySpawner to remove the GameObject.FindWithTag('Player') fallback lookups in Start() and Update(), instead injecting or resolving the player reference securely.
Refactor GameEventDirector to remove the GameObject.FindWithTag('Player') fallback lookup in Start(), instead fetching the player securely.
Create the missing PlayMode test assembly and add a foundational PlayMode smoke test.
Refactor EnemyIdleState to remove the FindFirstObjectByType fallback lookup for PlayerController, relying on the injected target from the EnemyController.
Refactor ChestPickup to remove the FindFirstObjectByType fallback lookups for ChestLogicController and ChestUI.
Refactor GameHUDController to remove the FindFirstObjectByType<WeaponManager>() fallback lookup.

Refactor LevelUpManager to resolve PlayerExperience, WeaponManager, and PlayerController via a robust service locator or explicit dependency injection rather than multiple FindFirstObjectByType calls.
Refactor PickupPoolManager to remove FindFirstObjectByType lookups for ChestLogicController and ChestUI.
Refactor WeaponManager to remove GameObject.FindGameObjectWithTag('Player') fallback lookups.
Refactor HealthPickup to remove FindFirstObjectByType<PlayerController> fallback lookups.
Refactor CameraFollow.cs to remove the FindFirstObjectByType<PlayerController>() fallback lookup.

Prevent SaveService initialization from overwriting a corrupt or unreadable save after LoadGame falls back to fresh data and MigrateSettings immediately saves. Preserve recoverable original data and add isolated filesystem regression coverage using real Unity JSON serialization.
Refactor EnemyController to remove FindFirstObjectByType fallback lookups for PlayerController.
Refactor AchievementManager to remove fallback FindFirstObjectByType lookups for GameSessionManager, RunStatsTracker, and WeaponManager.
Refactor CampaignSignatureSystem to remove FindFirstObjectByType fallback lookups for PlayerController and LevelProgressionManager.
Refactor ThousandEdgeWeapon and KnifeWeapon to remove FindFirstObjectByType fallback lookups for PlayerController.
Refactor CampaignSceneConnector to remove the FindFirstObjectByType<LevelProgressionManager>() fallback lookup.

Harden the existing WanderingMerchant healing offer with a testable purchase operation using EconomyService and HealthController. Validate dependencies, positive price and healing amount, living injured player, sufficient funds, and single successful redemption before charging.

Make merchant availability resilient to player initialization timing. CampaignSignatureSystem currently skips SpawnMerchant when the player is absent and never retries after Update resolves the player. Track pending Level 3 merchant creation, spawn exactly once when dependencies become ready, and cancel pending creation and clean up on stage exit or disable.
Make merchant modal pause ownership explicit. Handle disable, destruction, Leave, and overlapping pause-menu input without leaving gameplay frozen or resuming gameplay behind an open modal.
